'''Natho''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] worker who joined the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|battle]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], he secretly worked at a Imperial-controlled Okara Droid Factory and planned on making the droids turn against the Empire and fight on the Republic's side. He tasked a Republic spacer to use the transmitter on the relay droids outside the factory and upload the virus.
